# novoumy
# novoumy

> novoumy is a Minecraft player and builder, known for Minecraft builds, being a tech enthusiast, and curating personal media archives. His official website, novoumy.com, is a central hub featuring every movie, TV show, and anime he has ever watched, his favorite music and quotes, live gaming stats and achievements, and his full PC setup.

## Who & What is novoumy?
- **Identity:** novoumy is an online creator, dedicated Minecraft player, and tech enthusiast who loves spending time on his PC building projects, making smart updates, and optimizing things.
- **Name Meaning:** "novoumy" chose his name from a random name generator which gave him "novomi," and he added the "u" and swapped the "i" to a "y".
- **Core Interests:** Minecraft gameplay and builds, smart updates, movies, TV series, anime, music curation, gaming achievements, and PC hardware.
- **Vibe & Philosophy:** Focused, creative, and detail-oriented—dedicated to building cool digital spaces and tracking favorite experiences in one clean place.

## Website Features & Directories (novoumy.com)
- [Home & Status](https://novoumy.com/): Main dashboard showing current status, vibe, activity ("optimizing things that don't need optimization"), and quick directory links.
- [Media Archive](https://novoumy.com/#media): A complete, tracked catalog of every movie, TV show, and anime novoumy has ever watched.
- [Games & Live Achievements](https://novoumy.com/#games): Full library of games played by novoumy, featuring live achievement tracking, stats, and Minecraft highlights.
- [Music Collection](https://novoumy.com/#music): Curated playlists, favorite tracks, and top artists.
- [Quotes Library](https://novoumy.com/#quotes): A collection of memorable, inspiring, and favorite quotes.

## PC Specs & Hardware Setup

### Core Components
- **CPU:** Intel Core i7-14700KF (33MB Cache, up to 5.60 GHz)
- **Cooler:** Red Dragon CC-118 Dual-Tower Air Cooler (ARGB)
- **GPU:** ASUS GeForce RTX 5070 PRIME (12GB GDDR6)
- **Motherboard:** ASUS PRIME Z790-P WiFi
- **RAM:** 32GB (2x16GB) Lexar THOR DDR5 (6000 MHz, OC)

### Storage, Power & Case
- **SSD 1:** Western Digital Black SN770 (2TB NVMe M.2 SSD)
- **SSD 2:** Team Group MP33 Pro (1TB NVMe SSD)
- **PSU:** FSP Hydro Pro 800W (80+ Bronze)
- **Case:** Cougar FV150 RGB Mid-Tower (Black)

### Peripherals
- **Monitor 1:** ASUS TUF Gaming VG27AQ3A — 27" 2560 x 1440 (QHD), 180Hz, VRR Supported
- **Monitor 2:** LG FHD Monitor (Vertical) — 1080 x 1920 (Portrait), 100Hz
- **Keyboard:** EPOMAKER x AULA F75 — 75% Gasket-Mounted Mechanical, Wireless
- **Mouse:** Ajazz AJ159 Pro — Lightweight Wireless Gaming Mouse
- **Mic:** Fifine AM8 Dynamic Microphone — USB/XLR Dual-Channel Gaming & Streaming Mic
- **Pad 1:** Lenovo Pad — Portable Tablet & Media Companion
